entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think we've started on the wrong..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we've started on the wrong foot here. Before we talk further, I want to raise a glass to all of you."
entries.menuText:
"I think we've started on the wrong foot here. Before we talk further, I want to raise a glass to all of you."
[Give the signal]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A wise man once said, 'Resistance..."
entries.dialogueText: "A wise man once said, 'Resistance to change is futile when the wheels of time turn unceasingly.'"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've called you in here as a court..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've called you in here as a courtesy to let you know that there's going to be some changes around here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you everyone for coming here..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you everyone for coming here this evening. I have something important to tell you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once inside, I closed the door, lea..."
entries.dialogueText: Once inside, I closed the door, leaving the celebrations behind us.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well, I think the curtain in this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I think the curtain in this room looks just fine, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a ripple of light laughte..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a ripple of light laughter among the group.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For centuries, the monarchy has be..."
entries.dialogueText: "For centuries, the monarchy has been the stabilizing force of Rizia..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You people have taken Rizia for gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "You people have taken Rizia for granted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia deserves more than the weigh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia deserves more than the weight of its history -- she deserves a future unshackled from the past."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a tense silence followed..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a tense silence followed by uneasy glances.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Resistance? To what, exactly?""
entries.dialogueText: "Resistance? To what, exactly?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was subtle, but it was enough."
entries.dialogueText: It was subtle, but it was enough.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To my mother, Queen Estela, and to..."
entries.dialogueText: "To my mother, Queen Estela, and to the future of Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I raised my glass."
entries.dialogueText: I raised my glass.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we lifted our glasses, the doors..."
entries.dialogueText: As we lifted our glasses, the doors clicked shut.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For a democratic Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "For a democratic Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now. I want everybody to listen to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now. I want everybody to listen to me very carefully."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The nobles exchanged confused looks..."
entries.dialogueText: The nobles exchanged confused looks, their unease growing.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can no longer ignore the growin..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can no longer ignore the growing reform movement nor their legitimate request to be granted their political rights."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is the time to heed the calls..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is the time to heed the calls of the people. They have been loud and clear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured to the servers to bring..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured to the servers to bring forth the paperwork they were holding.
entries.menuText: Gesture to the servers to bring the constitutional draft.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gestured at the servers to bring..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured at the servers to bring forth the paperwork they were holding.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They approached the table and laid..."
entries.dialogueText: They approached the table and laid the constitutional draft, "The Rizian Fundamental Law," upon it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So... I've gathered you here on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... I've gathered you here on this meaningful day to reform our great kingdom and finally give the people of Rizia the right to rule themselves."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Give me a break. This is a direct..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give me a break. This is a direct attack against the Rizian monarchy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grasped the wheels of his chair..."
entries.dialogueText: He grasped the wheels of his chair and turned toward the door.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, you must admit that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, you must admit that this is incredibly ill timing. Our focus should be on the war, not reform."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I did not leave the frontlines jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not leave the frontlines just to listen to this populist drivel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shut up and listen to me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Shut up and listen to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While the Crown has borne the weig..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the Crown has borne the weight of your greed and apathy, you grew fat on the very people you were meant to serve."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I see no heirs to this legacy,..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I see no heirs to this legacy, only scavengers circling a dying institution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But clinging too tightly to tradit..."
entries.dialogueText: "But clinging too tightly to tradition risks dragging us into ruin."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: "You’re speaking in riddles, dear.""
entries.dialogueText: You’re speaking in riddles, dear."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You’re speaking in riddles, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’re speaking in riddles, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You’re speaking in riddles, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’re speaking in riddles, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""You’re speaking in riddles, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’re speaking in riddles, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, Your Majesty... What exactly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty... What exactly is it you're implying?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Just what exactly are you implying?""
entries.dialogueText: "Just what exactly are you implying?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will be transferring the Crown's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be transferring the Crown's lawmaking powers to the House of Delegates entirely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright. I'll be clear. We are ref..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. I'll be clear. We are reforming the Kingdom with a new constitution, and you are not going to stand in its way."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Just what exactly are you implying?""
entries.dialogueText: "Just what exactly are you implying?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What I'm implying is that there wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I'm implying is that there will be changes. Changes that prioritizes the people of Rizia over the nobility."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chamber seemed to freeze, their..."
entries.dialogueText: The chamber seemed to freeze, their eyes reflecting shock and muted outrage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need you to sign these documents..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need you to sign these documents to show your support for the outlined changes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gave me a troubled glance."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gave me a troubled glance.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What changes?""
entries.dialogueText: "What changes?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That really doesn't matter. You wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "That really doesn't matter. You will have to accept the changes either way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Feel free to read the proposal in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Feel free to read the proposal in detail. When you've finished, add your signature, if you please."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know all of you have your own pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know all of you have your own personal opinions and concerns about this. That’s why I’ve brought you here -- to ensure we embrace this change together on the best possible terms."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The chamber seemed to freeze, their..."
entries.dialogueText: The chamber seemed to freeze, their eyes reflecting shock and muted outrage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a long silence, Hugo was the..."
entries.dialogueText: After a long silence, Hugo was the first to act. He leaned on the table and took a look at the proposal.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Really? You brought Sazon's propos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? You brought Sazon's proposal to us?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Really? You brought the RPP's prop..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? You brought the RPP's proposal to us?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""With all due respect, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, you cannot simply make that decision on your own."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Taddeus was the first to br..."
entries.dialogueText: General Taddeus was the first to break the silence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a matter of fact, I can.""
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, I can."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please, General. You must understa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, General. You must understand this is a necessity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you don't want any trouble, you..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you don't want any trouble, you'd better just play along and sign the documents."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone was seated around a long t..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone was seated around a long table, the taxidermied animal heads looming above them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody lifted a finger."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody lifted a finger.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You're completely out of your mind!""
entries.dialogueText: "You're completely out of your mind!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He folded his arms."
entries.dialogueText: He folded his arms.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""What's the meaning of this, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses listen to demands from communist thugs?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Sotelato's radicals?""
entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato's radicals?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The boy behind the protests?""
entries.dialogueText: "The boy behind the protests?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The traitor behind the protests?""
entries.dialogueText: "The traitor behind the protests?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The boy who wants to dismantle the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The boy who wants to dismantle the Rizian Crown?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""What's the meaning of this, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses listen to demands from enemies of the state?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""What's the meaning of this, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses bow to populism?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""What!?""
entries.dialogueText: "What!?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With all due respect, General, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, General, Mr. Sotelato is the leader of the RPP. He represents a greater part of the Rizian population than House Azaro does."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With all due respect, General, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, General, Mr. Sotelato is the Speaker of the House of Delegates. He represents a greater part of the Rizian population than House Azaro does."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I am standing right here, General.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am standing right here, General."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And with all due respect, as the l..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with all due respect, as the leader of the RPP, I represent a greater part of the Rizian population than House Azaro does."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Nobody wants to dismantle the mona..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody wants to dismantle the monarchy. The RPP only wants reforms. A true constitutional monarchy."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""House Sazon has nothing to do with..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon has nothing to do with this, General. Please be more respectful when speaking about my son."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""House Sazon has nothing to do with..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon has nothing to do with this, General. I advise you to be more respectful to my cousin."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Right. His absence speaks volumes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right. His absence speaks volumes."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""What's the meaning of this, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses listen to demands from anti-monarchists?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Sotelato's radicals?""
entries.dialogueText: "Sotelato's radicals?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""The traitor's son behind the prote..."
entries.dialogueText: "The traitor's son behind the protests?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""What's the meaning of this, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses bow to populism?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""The traitor's son who wants to dis..."
entries.dialogueText: "The traitor's son who wants to dismantle the Rizian Crown?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""What's the meaning of this, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's the meaning of this, Your Majesty? Since when do the noble houses listen to demands from enemies of the state?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""The traitor behind the protests?""
entries.dialogueText: "The traitor behind the protests?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Should have known he was part of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should have known he was part of this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So it is true. You were collaborat..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it is true. You were collaborating behind the scenes then? Without consulting the Royal Houses?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All eyes snapped to Manus, their ga..."
entries.dialogueText: All eyes snapped to Manus, their gazes filled with alarm.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Should have known he was part of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should have known he was part of this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo stood up and looked at me."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo stood up and looked at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If our monarchy is to survive this..."
entries.dialogueText: "If our monarchy is to survive this century, we must adapt. Fully empowering the House of Delegates and entrusting governance to the people is the only path forward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Rizian People's Party has alre..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian People's Party has already drafted the constitution together with the reform movement. It is more than evident that this is what the people want."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wholeheartedly support the calls..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wholeheartedly support the calls for reform. I ask you to do the same."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Feel free to read the proposal in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Feel free to read the proposal in detail. When you've finished, add your signature, if you please."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody lifted a finger."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody lifted a finger.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo leaned on the table and took a..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo leaned on the table and took a look at the proposal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others nodded in approval. Hugo..."
entries.dialogueText: The others nodded in approval. Hugo stood up and looked at me.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Is is true, Romus? You were collab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is is true, Romus? You were collaborating with this man behind the scenes? Against the wishes of the Royal Houses?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""None of that matters now, Hugo. Wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "None of that matters now, Hugo. What *does* matter is that these reforms will be enacted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had to hide it. You gave me no o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had to hide it. You gave me no other choice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is true. I won't become a monar..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is true. I won't become a monarch who desperately clings to power in this day and age. The reformists are right about Rizia's future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is true. When acceded the thron..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is true. When acceded the throne, I told everybody that I intended to reform the country, didn't I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not here to have a debate. Ple..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not here to have a debate. Please cooperate so we can move on."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Nobody will be signing anything. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody will be signing anything. What you're asking is unacceptable. You'll have no support from us, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Forcing our hand in this underhand..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forcing our hand in this underhanded way is not just unconventional -- it's a blatant insult to the Royal Houses of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""With all due respect, House Azaro..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, House Azaro will take its leave."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I will say right from the start th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will say right from the start that His Majesty's opinion does not reflect that of the rest of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""The need for such a radical action..."
entries.dialogueText: "The need for such a radical action is by no means evident, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The need for such a radical action..."
entries.dialogueText: "The need for such a radical action is by no means evident, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not so fast.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not so fast."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't let him leave.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't let him leave."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are mistaken. I am not *asking..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are mistaken. I am not *asking* for your support."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regardless of what happens today,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless of what happens today, I truly appreciate everyone who has supported me over the past few years."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, the doors clicked shut."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, the doors clicked shut.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where do you think you're going?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where do you think you're going?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a tense silence followed..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a tense silence followed by uneasy glances.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I must say I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "I must say I agree."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I must say I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "I must say I agree."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He is right.""
entries.dialogueText: "He is right."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""They are right.""
entries.dialogueText: "They are right."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I must say I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "I must say I agree."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""She's right.""
entries.dialogueText: "She's right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This isn't a joke.""
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't a joke."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Should have known he was part of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should have known he was part of this."
